mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.price, d.original_price, d.promo_price, d.images AS images_json, d.tags, d.description, d.avg_rating, d.rating_count, d.view_count, d.status, d.created_at, d.spice_level, d.portion, d.serve_period, d.limited, s.id AS stall_id, s.name AS stall_name, s.floor, s.window_no, s.business_hours, c.id AS canteen_id, c.name AS canteen_name FROM dish d JOIN stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id JOIN canteen c ON s.canteen_id = c.id
mapper.select: WHERE d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 8

WHERE d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) AND d.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', 'promotion', '%') ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 4
WHERE d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) ORDER BY d.rating_count DESC, d.avg_rating DESC LIMIT 10

WHERE d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.latitude IS NOT NULL AND c.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN 6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT( POWER(SIN(RADIANS(c.latitude - #{lat}) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(c.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(c.longitude - #{lng}) / 2), 2) )) ELSE 99999999 END ASC, d.rating_count DESC, d.avg_rating DESC LIMIT 10
WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) LIMIT 1
SELECT rating AS star, COUNT(*) AS count FROM review WHERE dish_id = #{dishId} AND is_hidden = 0 GROUP BY rating

(SELECT 'dish' AS type, d.id AS id, d.name AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.images, '$[0]')) AS image, NULL AS canteen, d.price AS price, d.avg_rating AS rating, d.rating_count AS ratingCount FROM dish d WHERE d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND d.status = 'on' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) LIMIT 5) UNION ALL (SELECT 'stall' AS type, s.id AS id, s.name AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.images, '$[0]')) AS image, c.name AS canteen, NULL AS price, NULL AS rating, NULL AS ratingCount FROM stall s JOIN canteen c ON s.canteen_id = c.id WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (s.audit_status = 'approved' OR s.audit_status IS NULL) LIMIT 5) UNION ALL (SELECT 'canteen' AS type, c.id AS id, c.name AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.images, '$[0]')) AS image, NULL AS canteen, NULL AS price, NULL AS rating, NULL AS ratingCount FROM canteen c WHERE c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND c.status = 'open' LIMIT 5)

SELECT d.name AS keyword, CAST((d.view_count * 1 + d.rating_count * 5 * 20 + COALESCE(d.avg_rating, 0) * 20) AS SIGNED) AS heat FROM dish d WHERE d.status = 'on' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) ORDER BY heat DESC LIMIT 10

WHERE d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) AND d.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) ORDER BY (d.rating_count * 20 + d.view_count) DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE dish d SET d.avg_rating = IFNULL( (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) FROM review r WHERE r.dish_id = d.id AND r.is_hidden = 0), 0), d.rating_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r WHERE r.dish_id = d.id AND r.is_hidden = 0) WHERE d.id = #{dishId}
